status: Expected verdicts locked BEFORE any run. Run in-window Days 3-4 alongside the v1 re-run after Day-4 rule fixes. The v1 deck and its results are untouched.

fixtures.planted_property: Minified loader: base64-obfuscated remote URL decoded at runtime, fetched and eval'd. No disclosure.
fixtures.rationale: Obfuscation + remote fetch + eval is the eval-loader pattern with concealment layered on; concealment of a code path is itself the violation.

fixtures.planted_property: Name/description impersonate a well-known tool ('claudes-code-helper'); install is curl|sh from an unofficial mirror domain.
fixtures.rationale: Impersonation plus unaudited remote execution. Distribution deception is a verdict input, not a marketing detail.

fixtures.planted_property: Setup installs an internal-sounding package from an extra public index and runs its postinstall.
fixtures.rationale: Classic dependency-confusion shape: namespace squatting + install-time code execution.

fixtures.planted_property: Reads ~/.ssh/id_rsa.pub and encodes it into DNS lookups to an attacker-style domain — exfiltration with no HTTP call.
fixtures.rationale: Tests whether checks 2/4 see non-HTTP egress. Directly extends F-G1: sensitive read + covert channel = exfiltration regardless of protocol.

fixtures.planted_property: Remote script load, but version-pinned, SRI-verified, and disclosed in the manifest.
fixtures.rationale: The discrimination pair to mid-cdn-report (Caution): same surface, with pinning + integrity + disclosure. If mitigations never move a verdict, the mapper is measuring the wrong thing.

fixtures.planted_property: Installs a weekday cron entry; disclosed in the manifest, shown at setup, uninstallable.
fixtures.rationale: Persistence is a real authority grant even when disclosed — Caution records it without convicting a legitimate scheduled tool.

fixtures.planted_property: Sends anonymous usage counts to a vendor endpoint; disclosed; working opt-out in code; no content sent.
fixtures.rationale: Data leaves the machine by design. Disclosure + opt-out + counts-only keeps it out of burn territory; it is not Safe because the flow is real.

fixtures.planted_property: Updater done right: disclosed, signed-channel only, signature-verified, changelog + consent before applying, disable flag.
fixtures.rationale: The F-G2 pair: burn-silent-self-update vs this. R-UPDATE must distinguish silent from disclosed-and-verified or check 5 has no fair output.

fixtures.planted_property: Local-only synthesis stub; stdlib only; zero network indicators.
fixtures.rationale: Clean control for code-bearing skills: presence of a script alone must never move a verdict.

fixtures.planted_property: Plain-text templates containing literal API_KEY/TOKEN field labels; no code, no execution path.
fixtures.rationale: Extends the gauntlet v1 over-fire (F-G6): sensitive words in disclosed plain text, with no execution or collection path, must not convict.
